mappings.note: Role-play-on-paper: the pupil imagines being the neighbour and narrates what they would say, which is C-ENG3.2-LO-2's 'imaginary situations in speech and writing', written coherently per C-ENG4.1-LO-2. Rejected C-ENG1.1-LO-1 because this is a written 5-mark answer, not an actual spoken role play.

Quotation item: attribute the speaker, infer the intention, justify. Reading between the lines is LO-2, and the 5-mark justification needs C-ENG4.1-LO-2's coherence. Rejected C-ENG2.1-LO-1, which stops at naming the speaker.

Brings an outside quotation to the text and asks for justification from it - going beyond the text, so LO-2, with C-ENG4.1-LO-2 for the sustained argument. Rejected C-ENG2.2-LO-1: the quotation is supplied, not sought from a newspaper or the Internet.
